name: Nairobi National Park
subtitle: A wildlife park just outside central Nairobi, managed within the city's edge.

facts.label: Anniversary
facts.value: Marked its 75th anniversary in December 2021 (implies 1946 founding; the page does not state 1946 directly)

facts.label: Wildlife (rhino)
facts.value: Hosts the endangered black rhino and over 400 bird species

facts.label: Uniqueness
facts.value: Described as only game reserve within the limits of a major city

parts.text: A wildlife park just outside central Nairobi, managed within the city's edge. EBSCO calls it the only wild game reserve within the city limits of a major metropolitan city.
